name: revenue_sdk

integrations._comment: Design strip frame 49l, commerce half of the seam (merchants_sdk >= 1.25.0): the merchants restaurant page never imports revenue_sdk (ADR-005 - SDKs import only base), so the pane arrives through the composer's substring-insert integration, the same mechanism productivity_sdk uses for its tasks-row line. This entry lands the barrel import under the column-0 imports marker; the pane entry below lands the widget. On a merchants_sdk without the markers the installer only warns (wiring NOT applied) and the hub keeps base's bare BaseWalletCard.

The placeholder carries its six-space indent ON PURPOSE: the bare text is a prefix of the -imports marker above, and the installer replaces every occurrence. The marker sits first inside MerchantWalletSection's candidate list and the section renders `.first`, so the inserted pane WINS over base's BaseWalletCard(actions: [], onHistory: null) that follows it; nothing is deleted. merchantWalletScope(ref) is the host page's own seam function (shop id + display name from restaurantProvider, cached shop JSON as fallback), so this replacement names no merchants internals beyond it. Byte-for-byte twin of merchants_sdk's markers - test/hub_markers_test.dart there pins both strings.

driver._comment_di_hooks: Driver migration M4: the driver-role revenue DI (CourierStatisticsRepositoryFacade for the installed profile/income pages) moved out of paas_driver's tracked dependency_manager.dart into the #160 di_hooks mechanism, mirroring commerce#17's manager role-DI entries. Direct src/ import by design - DriverRevenueDependencies is role code kept out of the barrel so a manager app's stripped cache still compiles (see driver_revenue_di.dart). register() is isRegistered-guarded, so a host that still calls it by hand during its own migration window double-boots safely.
driver._comment_top_up: Design strip frame 49f chip 973, since 1.12.0: DriverWalletPage draws Top up, which pushes delivery_sdk's /driver-deposits?choose=1 by PATH (ADR-005: revenue imports only base, so the two SDKs meet on the route). delivery_sdk >= 1.18.0 declares the route; on an older composition the push fails and the driver hears one friendly line instead of seeing nothing.

manager._comment_wallet_pane: Design strip frame 49l (manager withdraw, approved 2026-08-31 "49d, 49f-l approved"), revenue half since 1.11.0: the barrel exports ManagerWalletPane / ManagerWithdrawAction (src/common/presentation/manager_wallet/) and managerWalletProvider keyed by ManagerWalletScope(shopId, shopName). The merchants restaurant page (the commerce half, NOT in this SDK) mounts ManagerWalletPane(scope: ...) where it renders BaseWalletCard(actions: []) today; nothing else in revenue changes for that. The payout seam it resolves (DriverPayoutRepositoryFacade) is registered by the revenue-manager-role-di hook below as well as the driver hook. The server call is USER-scoped (wallet api.payout.request_payout, payout.py:350) and the scope is not sent - whether a shop withdraws to the shop's account or the manager's personal one is Ray's open question, flagged on the frame.
manager._comment_deposit_approvals: Design strip frame 49i, manager side, since 1.12.0: ManagerWalletPane draws a Deposits to approve entry (showDepositApprovals, default true) that pushes DepositApprovalsPage on the root navigator - the queue of Pending Wallet Deposit Request rows with Approve / Reject (reason required). depositApprovalsProvider resolves DepositApprovalRepositoryFacade, registered by the revenue-manager-role-di hook only (approve/reject are role-gated server-side and no driver surface draws the queue). Server: RokctAI/pay wallet frappe api.wallet.list_pending_deposit_requests / approve_deposit_request / reject_deposit_request; a tenant without that backend answers 404 and the page states the failure.
manager._comment_di_hooks: Manager migration: the manager-role revenue DI (SellerStatisticsRepositoryFacade, resolved by the installed income page's statisticsProvider and profitDashboardProvider) was defined in src/manager/di/manager_revenue_di.dart but never CALLED at boot - no host wired it by hand and this block had no di_hooks entry, so paas_manager's /income crashed with 'GetIt: Object/factory with type SellerStatisticsRepositoryFacade is not registered inside GetIt'. This entry mirrors the app_type.driver revenue-driver-role-di hook above and merchants_sdk's merchants-manager-role-di. Order 14 rather than 12 because kitchen_sdk and merchants_sdk already both declare 12 in the manager flavour - the injector keeps every hook but prints an order-collision warning per shared order, and these role registrations are independent, so a free slot inside the same role-DI band (before orders_sdk's pos-facades at 20) keeps the compose log clean. Direct src/ import by design - ManagerRevenueDependencies is role code kept out of the barrel so a driver app's stripped cache still compiles. register() is isRegistered-guarded, so a host that also calls it by hand double-boots safely.
manager._comment: Manager income rewrite (approved design section 36, chips 654-674): the old non-compiling income templates (app_bar_screen + widgets/) are replaced by one template shell; all machinery lives in lib/src/manager (profit application slice + presentation/revenue). Keys the sibling SDKs already declare (today, delivered, cancelled, cooking, accepted, new, on_a_way, price, cost, cost_not_set, back) are intentionally NOT redeclared - the installer keeps the first declaring SDK (products_sdk/orders_sdk/base). The route stays /income ManagerIncomeRoute (CupertinoRoute) - the profile hub's entry is unchanged.

_comment_tr_keys: app_type.<role>.tr_keys: translation keys that role's income templates use that base_sdk's TrKeys does not declare. driver adds deliverymanTransactions and doneOrders, with the exact key strings from paas_driver's legacy lib/infrastructure/services/tr_keys.dart (doneOrders' value really is the display string 'Done orders' upstream - kept verbatim so existing backend translation data keeps matching). Manager block: sdk_installer_base stores them per-package and update_tr_keys_registration() injects them into the composed tr_keys.dart between the @sdk-tr-keys-start/end markers, so TrKeys.needOrder etc. resolve at build time. Values are the exact key strings from paas_manager's legacy lib/infrastructure/services/tr_keys.dart, so existing backend translation data keeps matching. None of these names exist in base_sdk's tr_keys.dart (checked against core@main) - adding one that does would recreate the duplicate-'payment' collision the composed build already flags.
_comment_app_type: Both personas now get a real page install. manager: templates/pages/manager/income -> lib/presentation/pages/income (ManagerIncomeRoute, CupertinoRoute). driver: templates/pages/driver/income -> the same host path (DriverIncomeRoute, MaterialRoute - matching zones_sdk's DriverDeliveryZoneRoute convention); since 1.2.0 the driver templates no longer import the host's services/components/styles barrels or a host-owned application/statistics layer - they resolve against base_sdk (services, AppStyle, promoted components) and this SDK's src/driver/application/statistics slice (notifier/state/provider over CourierStatisticsRepositoryFacade, ported from paas_driver), the same shape as the manager templates. The chart uses charts_flutter: the SDK slice emits plain OrdinalSales rows (src/driver/infrastructure/models/chart.dart) and the installed income_page builds the Series in the HOST package. Since 1.10.1 charts_flutter is declared in THIS SDK's pubspec (the same git fork the pre-fork paas_driver pinned, with an intl ^0.20.2 override mirroring the host template): the host pubspec is generated from core/base/dart/templates/pubspec.yaml, which never carried it, so the template's import only resolved on hosts that happened to pin it by hand. test/driver_income_template_deps_test.dart pins that every package a template imports is declared here (or is a composition peer). Driver also keeps the directly-imported lib/src/driver/ slice, and declaring both personas keeps the matching lib/src/ role folder alive through sdk_composer.py's strip_unused_role_folders. A non-manager, non-driver app that composes revenue_sdk still gets the package and its DI registration, but no pages and no role-specific code kept in cache. Requires .rokct/config/app_type to contain the matching value - resolve_app_type() returns None without it and no flavour block fires. Both installs are whole-directory copies, so verify lib/presentation/pages/income actually lands after composing.
_comment_routes: Each persona's income_page.dart carries @RoutePage(name: '...IncomeRoute') (ManagerIncomeRoute / DriverIncomeRoute) and installs into the HOST's lib/, so auto_route codegen generates the route class there - which is why these routes import the installed page directly via ${package} rather than needing a *_route_pages.dart wrapper the way auth_sdk does.
